eli.sec: Org advisory: mandatory rotation of DB TDE (Transparent Data Encryption) master keys and support for BYOK (bring-your-own-KMS). Goal: reduce blast radius from long-lived master keys and give teams control over keys. Enforcement window: key rotation required by 2027-01-15 for hosted DBs. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/db-tde-rotation :rotating_light:

deploy-bot: db-key-scan results: 58 DB instances using default-hosted master keys >360 days, 14 instances with no key-owner metadata, 7 instances using external-managed keys with expiring grants. Report: https://redwood.internal/reports/db-tde-scan-2140123456

mira-db: timeline? will Dedicated/private be auto-rotated?

eli.sec: Timeline: owner notifications start 2026-12-01; reminders 2026-12-15; final enforcement/rotation 2027-01-15. Hosted: security will perform rotation for default-hosted keys if owner does not act. Dedicated/private: we'll provide onboarding docs and tooling but cannot rotate customer-managed keys without coordination; customers can opt into our key-rotation job if they delegate key-grant rights.

zane.eng: what does BYOK onboarding look like (AWS KMS / GCP CMEK / Azure Key Vault)?

eli.sec: BYOK basics in runbook. Short examples: AWS KMS create key and attach grant/policy: `aws kms create-key --description "redwood-db-byok-{{team}}"` then use `modify-db-instance` to set `--kms-key-id arn:aws:kms:...:key/abc`. GCP CMEK: create keyring/key and grant `cloudsql.admin` service agent access, then update DB instance with `--disk-encryption-key`. Azure: use Key Vault key and grant `Microsoft.Sql/servers` access via managed identity, then update TDE protector. Detailed step-by-step in runbook.

claire.ops: will rotation cause brief unavailability during rekew/rotation?

mira-db: For most engines rotation is online but may trigger brief metadata lock or background rewrap; expected <30s for supported engines. We'll run rotations in rolling fashion and provide a dry-run mode. Critical OLTP clusters can request a maintenance window.

eli.sec: Action items for DB owners (short):
1) Add owner metadata (team, owner-email) to DB instance by 2026-12-15.
2) Rotate hosted master key or configure BYOK and rotate key material by 2027-01-15.
3) For mission-critical clusters, schedule a maintenance window and file `db-rotation:hold` with mitigation steps.

ops-bot: CSV export queued. Use: `https://api.redwood.internal/db/instances?filter=old_master_key&format=csv` Platform leads will receive per-team lists.

zane.eng: can security provide sample terraform snippets for KMS-binding to avoid manual steps?

eli.sec: Yes, runbook includes Terraform examples for AWS KMS and GCP CMEK. Example (minimal AWS snippet):
```
resource "aws_kms_key" "redwood_db" {
  description = "redwood db key for team-xyz"
  rotation_enabled = true
}
resource "aws_iam_role_policy" "kms_grant" {
  role = aws_iam_role.db_service.name
  policy = jsonencode({
    Statement = [{Effect = "Allow", Action = ["kms:Decrypt","kms:Encrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"], Resource = aws_kms_key.redwood_db.arn}]
  })
}
```

mira-db: For hosted rotation automation we support a dry-run mode (`--dry-run`) that reports expected impact. We'll run an org-wide dry-run on 2026-12-20 and publish results.

claire.ops: exceptions? some legacy read-replicas use an external hardware module we can't rotate quickly.

eli.sec: Exceptions accepted via `sec-exception:db-keys` ticket with owner, justification, and expiry. Short-term holds (max 30d) granted for migration windows; long-term exceptions require GRC review and compensating controls (e.g., restricted network egress, enhanced auditing).

deploy-bot: automation note: instances without owner metadata will be auto-notified and flagged for escalation after two reminders. We will perform a last-ditch automated rotation for unclaimed hosted instances on 2027-01-15 and notify infra on completion.

zane.eng: is there a way to test BYOK integration in staging before issuing keys to prod?

mira-db: yes, we recommend staging tests: create a staging key, attach to a staging DB, run `pgbench`/smoke tests, then simulate rotation. We also provide a helper script `tools/db_key_rotate_check.sh --instance <id> --dry-run` in the runbook.

eli.sec: Quick checklist recap:
- Inventory: export CSV and identify impacted DBs.
- Owners: add owner metadata by 2026-12-15.
- Hosted DBs: rotate hosted keys or configure BYOK by 2027-01-15.
- Dedicated/Private: follow BYOK onboarding guide and coordinate with infra; we offer migration assist.
- Exceptions: `sec-exception:db-keys`.

claire.ops: ack, will schedule a rotation sprint and ask Platform for per-team CSVs.

ops-bot: per-team CSVs DM'ing platform leads now.

eli.sec: We'll post progress updates here and in #platform. If you want your team's list earlier ping me or DM deploy-bot. Thanks — please prioritize DB key owners. :lock:
